pacing_correction.original_load_and_capture: std sleep/usleep below one FreeRTOS tick invokes esp_rom_delay_us in pinned IDF components/newlib/src/time.c, consuming CPU. Original task runtime includes pacing cost. Mixed-load pure encode failure remains observed; growing backlog means most later blocks did not wait for future deadlines.
pacing_correction.capture_yield: Corrected wait_until and phase-end commit use vTaskDelay(1); at most eight consecutive overdue blocks before additional one-tick fairness yield. No source block skips; tick rounding affects start/finish lateness.
pacing_correction.interpretation: Final backlog zero means the synthetic average workload caught up. It does not clear transient deadline violations, including 508374us pure encode elapsed stall during TLS.

mixed_flac_decoder_verification.correction: Original one-peer false verdict was a live framehash-reader throughput failure; rereading completed retained files proves exact requested samples for both decoders, with no checked decoder frame-number warnings or decoded timestamp discontinuities. The summary fields named skipped_source_audio_frames and duplicate_audio_frames reflect timestamp accounting, not proof against repeated or omitted capture content with continuous timestamps. Stable firmware capture counters are separate evidence. Original verdict remains preserved.

limitations: Capture start/end deltas exclude startup faults; startup counters are retained explicitly. Stable counters do not prove every DMA interrupt or exact ADC continuity in no-listener tests.
MQTT background connection failures/timeouts remained present; no attribution of encoder stalls to MQTT/TLS/cache/PSRAM contention is established.

Codec-exclusive entry omits only FLAC stream startup while retaining production capture allocations, network, SNTP, mDNS, controller, web and MQTT. It is a test of alternatives, not a shipping fix by disabling FLAC.
